title: Pitchaamo
head-description: Pitchaamo is PRG's game development incubator. Get mentoring and support as you develop your game idea into the first playable demos.
head-keywords: Pitchaamo, PRG, game development, game incubator, game projects, mentoring, playable demo, multidisciplinary collaboration
og-title: Pitchaamo – From game idea to demo
og-description: Develop your game idea with Pitchaamo. Explore mentoring, multidisciplinary collaboration, and projects in development.
idea-description: Start with your own game idea
intro-description: Pitchaamo is PRG's game development incubator. It gives you an easy way to get started, with space to develop your game idea and opportunities to share your work. You can take your idea all the way to the first playable demos.
intro-description2: At Pitchaamo, you can combine creative thinking, technical implementation, production, and collaboration across disciplines. As your idea develops, we can help build a multidisciplinary team to move the project forward with you.
team-description: We build a multidisciplinary team around you
development-description: Combine creative thinking with technical implementation
demo-description: Work toward your first playable demo
pitch-offer-2: A game development platform to bring your idea to life
pitch-offer-3: The opportunity to work on a thesis project
pitch-offer-4: Experience working in the games industry and learning how it operates
pitch-offer-5: The chance to work in a multidisciplinary team
pitch-offer-6: Opportunities to showcase your work through Creative Crossroads
why-join-development-description: For us, game development is an artistic endeavor as well as a technical and production process. We want to combine creative thinking and technical implementation from the earliest stages of game development.
why-join-collaboration-description: You'll gain experience working with people such as visual artists, writers, programmers, game designers, and sound designers. As your idea develops, we can build a multidisciplinary team around you.
why-join-ownership-description: Your ideas and creations stay yours. We want to give you room to develop your own game and the opportunity to take it further in your future projects.
project-extraterritory-description: A pilot project developed through Pitchaamo.
project-map-ink-description: A game that highlights different forms of drawing and promotes art education.
project-time-clock-description: A React app developed as a thesis project that helps companies track their employees' working hours.
join-description: Do you have a game idea you'd like to develop further or try out in practice?
join-description2: Get in touch! We're also happy to answer any questions about Pitchaamo.
followus-description: Follow the Creative Crossroads channels for project news and the latest updates from Pitchaamo.
prg-title: Learn more about PRG and our other projects.
